generic.Defined scope/population: Annuity in-payout lives only - immediate, deferred-in-payout and structured settlement, excluding all life-block policies
generic.In-scope period: The mortality study observation window ending at the agreed annuity study cut-off date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attained age, gender, annuity type, impairment flag and annual income present on every in-payout record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Annuity exposure lives and annualised income tie to the policy admin in-payout report at cut-off
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Longevity exhibit workbook saved in the study folder with run date and Prophet model version stamped
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies appearing in both life and annuity extracts logged and removed with the reason recorded
generic.Test population: All annuity in-payout exposure cells by attained age band and gender in the study extract
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero life-block records in the annuity exposure file and an A/E produced for every populated age band
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained longevity divergence from the life-block A/E escalated to the Valuation Actuary before release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Longevity exhibit shows annuity-only exposure, A/E by age band and gender, and a written divergence note
generic.Evidence location: Study folder in the model governance repository holding the longevity exhibit and Prophet run outputs

steps.title: Isolate annuity in-payout exposure in the study extract
sop: Filter the study extract to in-payout annuity contracts using the product code list agreed for the study.
Remove any policy key that also appears in the life-block exposure file.
Done when the annuity exposure file contains in-payout contracts only.
verify: Join the annuity and life exposure files on policy key and count overlaps.
Pass when the overlap count is zero.

steps.title: Split annuity exposure into product cells in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assign each contract to immediate, deferred-in-payout or structured settlement using the product mapping tab.
Report exposure lives and annualised income for each cell.
Done when every contract carries exactly one product cell.
verify: Sum cell exposure and compare to the total annuity exposure.
Pass when the cell totals equal the file total.

steps.title: Flag impaired and underwritten annuity lives as a separate cell
sop: Read the underwriting or impairment indicator from the policy record for each in-payout contract.
Tag impaired lives into their own analysis cell rather than blending into standard lives.
Done when impaired lives are separately identified and counted.
verify: Check that the impaired cell exposure is non-zero where the block contains impaired business.
Pass when impaired lives are reported as a distinct cell.

steps.title: Run expected annuitant deaths on the current basis in FIS Prophet
sop: Load the annuity exposure file into the Prophet longevity study run.
Run expected deaths on the current valuation annuitant table and record the table version.
Done when expected deaths are produced for every exposure cell.
verify: Confirm the run log names the annuitant table version used.
Pass when expected deaths exist for all populated cells with the basis recorded.

steps.title: Build the A/E longevity exhibit by age band and gender in Microsoft Excel
sop: Aggregate actual and expected deaths into bands 55-64, 65-74, 75-84 and 85 plus, split by gender.
Compute A/E per cell and add a reconciling total row.
Done when the exhibit shows A/E for every populated age band and gender.
verify: Check the total row equals the sum of cell numerators over cell denominators.
Pass when the aggregate A/E reconciles with no rounding drift.

steps.title: Compare annuity A/E to the life-block A/E and write the divergence note
sop: Place the annuity longevity A/E alongside the life-block mortality A/E for the same period.
Write the explanation for the divergence covering selection, underwriting and mix effects.
Done when the written comparison is filed with the exhibit.
verify: Read the note and confirm it explains each material divergence by age band.
Pass when every material divergence has a written explanation.

steps.title: File the longevity analysis in the actuarial modeling platform study folder
sop: Save the exhibit, exposure file and model run outputs to the study folder.
Stamp the pack with run date and model version.
Done when the pack is filed and retrievable by study reference.
verify: Reopen the filed pack and confirm the version stamp is present.
Pass when the pack is retrievable with its version stamp intact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every mortality risk cell in the study for which a raw A/E has been produced and a credibility factor is required
generic.In-scope period: The full experience study period used to accumulate expected claims for the credibility standard
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure, actual claims, expected claims and complement source populated for each risk cell
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Weighted claims across cells reconcile to the raw study claim totals before and after weighting
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Credibility workbook saved with method, parameters and run date recorded on the cover tab
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells below the credibility floor logged with the grouping decision applied to them
generic.Test population: All risk cells in the credibility grid including grouped low-exposure cells
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Credibility factor Z between zero and one for every cell and no isolated cell below the agreed floor
generic.Exception handling path: Cells that cannot be grouped to reach the floor referred to the Valuation Actuary for a judgement call
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Credibility exhibit shows Z, exposure, raw A/E and weighted A/E for every risk cell
generic.Evidence location: Experience study folder in the model governance repository holding the credibility workbook

steps.title: Select the credibility method and record the justification
sop: Compare Buhlmann-Straub against limited fluctuation for the study data volume and heterogeneity.
Record the selected method and the reason on the study file cover tab.
Done when the method is selected and justified in writing.
verify: Read the cover tab and confirm the method and rationale are stated.
Pass when the selected method has a written justification.

steps.title: Set the full-credibility standard in expected claims
sop: State the full-credibility standard in expected claims or death counts, not policy counts.
Record the confidence level and tolerance underlying the standard.
Done when the standard is documented with its parameters.
verify: Check the standard is expressed in claims terms with parameters shown.
Pass when the standard is stated in expected claims with parameters.

steps.title: Name the complement of credibility for each risk cell
sop: Assign each cell a complement from industry table, prior assumption or aggregated own experience.
Record the complement source as a field on the credibility grid.
Done when every cell carries a named complement.
verify: Filter the grid for blank complement fields.
Pass when no cell has a blank complement source.

steps.title: Compute credibility factor Z per cell in the SAS Actuarial Platform
sop: Run the credibility routine over the cell-level exposure and expected claims.
Output Z alongside exposure volume for each cell.
Done when Z is computed for every risk cell.
verify: Check Z values fall within zero to one inclusive.
Pass when no cell has a Z outside the zero to one range.

steps.title: Group cells falling below the credibility floor
sop: Identify cells with Z below the agreed floor from the Z output.
Group them into the agreed higher-level cell rather than weighting them in isolation.
Done when no isolated sub-floor cell remains in the grid.
verify: Re-run Z on the grouped cells and inspect the results.
Pass when every published cell meets or exceeds the credibility floor.

steps.title: Produce the credibility-weighted A/E grid in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply Z to the raw A/E and one minus Z to the named complement for each cell.
Show exposure, raw A/E, Z, complement and weighted A/E on one grid.
Done when the weighted grid covers every risk cell.
verify: Recompute a sample of cells by hand from the grid inputs.
Pass when the sampled recomputations match the published weighted A/E.

steps.title: Review the weighted results and file the credibility exhibit
sop: Review the weighted grid for smooth progression across adjacent cells.
File the exhibit in the experience study folder with method and run date stamped.
Done when the reviewed exhibit is filed.
verify: Confirm the filed exhibit carries the review sign-off and run date.
Pass when the filed exhibit shows a dated review sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Company mortality experience by age band and gender used to fit historical improvement rates
generic.In-scope period: At least ten study years, with the exact observation window stated on the trend exhibit
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calendar year, attained age band, gender, deaths and exposure populated for every study year
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Annual deaths and exposure by year reconcile to the mortality study dataset totals
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trend workbook and population data extracts saved with source vintage and run date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: COVID-affected calendar years logged with the include or exclude decision and its justification
generic.Test population: All fitted improvement cells by age band and gender across the stated observation window
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Observation window stated, and volatility reported for every fitted improvement rate
generic.Exception handling path: Cells with statistically insignificant trends referred to the Valuation Actuary rather than published as fitted
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Improvement trend exhibit shows fitted annual improvement by age band with the observation window stated
generic.Evidence location: Mortality study folder in the model governance repository holding the trend workbook and source extracts

steps.title: Assemble the multi-year mortality series from the data warehouse
sop: Pull deaths and exposure by calendar year, age band and gender for at least ten study years.
Confirm the series uses one consistent exposure basis across all years.
Done when a complete annual series is assembled for the stated window.
verify: Compare annual totals to the mortality study dataset for the overlapping years.
Pass when annual deaths and exposure agree with the study dataset.

steps.title: State the observation window and its treatment of COVID years
sop: Fix the start and end study years for the trend fit and record them on the exhibit.
Decide whether COVID-affected calendar years are included or excluded and justify it.
Done when the window and COVID treatment are documented.
verify: Read the exhibit header for the window and the COVID decision.
Pass when both the window and the COVID treatment are stated.

steps.title: Fit annual improvement rates by age band in Microsoft Excel
sop: Fit the improvement trend separately for each age band and gender rather than all lives combined.
Record the fitted annual rate and the fit statistics per cell.
Done when fitted rates exist for every age band and gender cell.
verify: Check that no cell reports a single all-lives rate in place of a fitted cell rate.
Pass when every published cell has its own fitted rate.

steps.title: Benchmark own improvement against published population data
sop: Load SSA, HMD or CMI improvement series for the same period and age bands.
Place own-company improvement alongside the population series for comparison.
Done when the comparison covers every fitted age band.
verify: Confirm the source and vintage of the population series is named on the exhibit.
Pass when the external series is named with its vintage.

steps.title: Report volatility and significance of each fitted trend
sop: Compute standard errors or confidence intervals around each fitted improvement rate.
Mark cells whose trend is not statistically distinguishable from zero.
Done when significance is reported for every fitted cell.
verify: Check that low-credibility cells are marked on the face of the exhibit.
Pass when no low-credibility cell is presented without a volatility marker.

steps.title: Load the fitted improvement series into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Import the fitted improvement rates into the modeling platform improvement input structure.
Confirm the platform accepts the age-band and gender granularity used.
Done when the fitted series loads without structural errors.
verify: Read back the loaded improvement grid and compare to the workbook.
Pass when the loaded grid matches the fitted workbook values.

steps.title: Review and file the mortality improvement trend exhibit
sop: Review the fitted rates, benchmark comparison and volatility markers together.
File the exhibit in the mortality study folder with run date stamped.
Done when the reviewed exhibit is filed.
verify: Confirm the filed exhibit shows window, fitted rates and a dated review.
Pass when all three elements are present on the filed exhibit.

generic.Defined scope/population: All company mortality risk classes being compared to the named industry benchmark table
generic.In-scope period: The experience study period over which company A/E ratios to the benchmark are computed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Company risk class, benchmark class, gender, smoker status and duration present on every mapped cell
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Amount-basis and count-basis A/E denominators both reconcile to the study exposure file
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmarking workbook saved with the benchmark table vintage and run date on the cover tab
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells deviating beyond the agreed tolerance logged with a written explanation
generic.Test population: Every company risk class mapped to a benchmark class in the benchmarking grid
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Benchmark vintage named, and A/E shown on both amount and count bases for all mapped cells
generic.Exception handling path: Unmappable company risk classes escalated to the Valuation Actuary before the exhibit is issued
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Benchmarking exhibit names the industry table vintage and shows A/E by amount and by count
generic.Evidence location: Experience study folder in the model governance repository holding the benchmarking workbook

steps.title: Name the benchmark table and its exact vintage
sop: Select the industry table to benchmark against, such as the 2015 VBT smoker-distinct table.
Record the table name, vintage and any relative risk variant on the workbook cover tab.
Done when the benchmark table is fully identified in writing.
verify: Read the cover tab for the table name and vintage.
Pass when the exact table vintage is recorded.

steps.title: Map company risk classes to benchmark classes
sop: Build a mapping table from each company risk class to its benchmark class.
Save the mapping in the study file so the comparison is reproducible.
Done when every company risk class carries a benchmark mapping.
verify: Filter the mapping table for unmapped company classes.
Pass when no company risk class is left unmapped.

steps.title: Load the benchmark table into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Import the benchmark rates into the modeling platform under the mapped class structure.
Run expected deaths on the benchmark basis over the study exposure.
Done when benchmark expected deaths are produced for all cells.
verify: Check the run log names the loaded benchmark table.
Pass when the run log identifies the benchmark table used.

steps.title: Compute A/E on amount and count bases in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute A/E using face amount as the measure for each mapped cell.
Repeat the computation using lives or policy counts as the measure.
Done when both bases are produced for every mapped cell.
verify: Reconcile both denominators back to the study exposure file.
Pass when both bases reconcile to the exposure totals.

steps.title: Benchmark select and ultimate periods separately
sop: Split the comparison by policy duration into select and ultimate segments.
Produce A/E for each segment rather than a blended ratio.
Done when select and ultimate A/E are reported separately.
verify: Confirm no published cell blends select and ultimate durations.
Pass when select and ultimate ratios appear as separate lines.

steps.title: List cells breaching the agreed deviation tolerance
sop: Apply the agreed tolerance to the A/E ratios against the benchmark.
List each breaching cell with a written explanation of the likely driver.
Done when every breaching cell has an explanation.
verify: Check the breach list for entries lacking explanations.
Pass when no breaching cell is listed without an explanation.

steps.title: Review and file the benchmarking exhibit
sop: Review the mapping, both A/E bases and the breach explanations together.
File the exhibit in the experience study folder with vintage and run date stamped.
Done when the reviewed exhibit is filed.
verify: Reopen the filed exhibit and confirm the review sign-off and vintage.
Pass when the filed exhibit carries a dated sign-off and the table vintage.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reserving, Pricing and Capital Modeling teams that consume the updated mortality and longevity assumption set

generic.Evidence location: Assumption release folder in Microsoft 365 SharePoint linked from the model governance repository

steps.title: Draft the release note naming version and effective date
sop: State the assumption set version id, effective date and first reporting period it applies to.
Keep the note to the changed assumptions rather than restating the full study.
Done when the draft note carries version, effective date and first period.
verify: Read the draft for the three mandatory identifiers.
Pass when version id, effective date and first period are all present.

steps.title: Add the impact summary by block to the release note
sop: Summarise the direction and rough magnitude of impact for each affected block.
Keep the summary at a level that lets teams plan their model runs.
Done when every affected block has an impact line.
verify: Check each affected block appears in the impact summary.
Pass when no affected block is missing from the summary.

steps.title: Link the approved assumption file in the model governance repository
sop: Insert the repository link to the approved assumption file version.
Remove any attached copies so teams cannot consume a stale file.
Done when the note links the repository file and carries no attachments.
verify: Open the link from the issued note and confirm it resolves to the approved version.
Pass when the link resolves to the named approved version.

steps.title: Issue the release note to Reserving, Pricing and Capital Modeling
sop: Send the note to the full distribution list through Microsoft Teams or email.
Request written acknowledgement with a stated response deadline.
Done when the note is issued to every team on the list.
verify: Compare the send list to the distribution list of record.
Pass when every listed team received the note.

steps.title: Confirm receipt with the Reserving team
sop: Review the release note and the linked assumption file version.
Reply in writing confirming receipt and the cycle in which it will be adopted.
Done when the written confirmation is sent.
verify: Locate the Reserving acknowledgement in the release folder.
Pass when a dated Reserving acknowledgement is filed.

steps.title: Confirm receipt with the Pricing team
sop: Review the release note and check which pricing models consume the assumption.
Reply in writing confirming receipt and the planned adoption run.
Done when the written confirmation is sent.
verify: Locate the Pricing acknowledgement in the release folder.
Pass when a dated Pricing acknowledgement is filed.

steps.title: Track acknowledgements and log adoption exceptions
sop: Record each acknowledgement against the distribution list in SharePoint.
Log a dated exception for any team unable to adopt by the effective date.
Done when every team is either acknowledged or exception-logged.
verify: Review the tracking sheet for teams with neither status.
Pass when no team is left without an acknowledgement or a logged exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: All mortality risk cells in the study exposure file for which actual and expected deaths are computed
generic.In-scope period: The experience study period defined for the mortality study, ending at the agreed cut-off date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Age band, gender, smoker status, duration, product, exposure and death counts populated on every cell
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cell-level actual and expected deaths sum to the aggregate totals with no rounding drift
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: A/E workbook saved with the valuation basis version and run date recorded on the exhibit
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells below the minimum expected deaths flagged as non-credible with the treatment recorded
generic.Test population: Every populated risk cell in the A/E exhibit including the reconciling total row
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Aggregate A/E ties to the sum of cell numerators and denominators within the stated rounding tolerance
generic.Exception handling path: Cells failing to reconcile referred back to the exposure build before the exhibit is issued
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A/E exhibit shows actual deaths, expected deaths and ratio by cell with a reconciling total row
generic.Evidence location: Mortality study folder in the model governance repository holding the A/E workbook and model outputs

steps.title: Load the study exposure file into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Import the exposed-to-risk and death dataset into the mortality study run.
Confirm the segmentation keys survive the import intact.
Done when the exposure loads with all segmentation keys present.
verify: Compare loaded record counts to the source exposure file.
Pass when loaded counts equal source counts.

steps.title: Run expected deaths on the current valuation basis
sop: Run expected deaths using the current valuation mortality basis.
Record the basis version id on the exhibit rather than in the run log only.
Done when expected deaths are produced with the basis version recorded.
verify: Read the exhibit header for the valuation basis version.
Pass when the basis version appears on the exhibit.

steps.title: Compute A/E on face amount and policy count bases
sop: Compute A/E using face amount as the measure for every cell.
Repeat using policy counts and keep both bases on the same exhibit.
Done when both bases exist for every populated cell.
verify: Reconcile both sets of denominators to the exposure file.
Pass when both bases reconcile to the exposure totals.

steps.title: Segment the ratios by age, gender, smoker, duration and product
sop: Aggregate the A/E to age band, gender, smoker status, duration and product cells.
Confirm no segmentation dimension has been silently collapsed.
Done when the exhibit carries all five segmentation dimensions.
verify: Inspect the exhibit for each of the five dimensions.
Pass when all five dimensions are present.

steps.title: Flag non-credible cells on the face of the exhibit
sop: Apply the agreed minimum expected deaths threshold to each cell.
Mark cells below the threshold as non-credible on the exhibit itself.
Done when every sub-threshold cell is visibly flagged.
verify: Filter the exhibit for sub-threshold cells without a flag.
Pass when no sub-threshold cell is unflagged.

steps.title: Reconcile the aggregate A/E to the cell-level totals
sop: Sum cell actual and expected deaths and recompute the aggregate ratio.
Compare to the reported aggregate A/E and investigate any difference.
Done when the aggregate reconciles within the rounding tolerance.
verify: Read the reconciliation row on the exhibit.
Pass when the reconciling difference is within the stated tolerance.

steps.title: Review and file the A/E exhibit
sop: Review the segmentation, credibility flags and reconciliation together.
File the exhibit in the mortality study folder with run date stamped.
Done when the reviewed exhibit is filed.
verify: Confirm the filed exhibit carries a dated review sign-off.
Pass when the filed exhibit shows a dated sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force and terminated policies contributing exposure to the mortality study, by age band, gender and product

steps.title: Fix the exposure basis for the study

Done when the exposure basis is stated in the study file.
verify: Read the study file for the stated exposure basis.
Pass when the basis is documented before calculation starts.

steps.title: Build exposed-to-risk in the SAS Actuarial Platform
sop: Compute exposure per policy on the chosen basis over the study period.
Apply the same routine to every product so the basis stays consistent.
Done when exposure is computed for every policy record.
verify: Check for policies with null or negative exposure.
Pass when no policy carries null or negative exposure.

steps.title: Match death records to exposure records by policy key
sop: Join the death records to the exposure file on policy key.
List every unmatched death for investigation with the source system.
Done when the match is complete and unmatched records are listed.
verify: Count unmatched death records after investigation and rework.
Pass when zero unmatched death records remain.

steps.title: Allocate partial exposure for mid-period status changes
sop: Identify reinstatements, conversions and face changes occurring mid-period.
Allocate partial exposure to each affected segment so no policy is double counted.
Done when all mid-period changes carry partial exposure.
verify: Sum exposure for affected policies and compare to the full-period maximum.
Pass when no affected policy exceeds its maximum possible exposure.

steps.title: Segment exposure by age, gender, smoker, duration and product
sop: Assign each exposure record to an age band, gender, smoker status, duration and product code.
Confirm no record falls outside the defined segmentation categories.
Done when every record is fully segmented.
verify: Filter for records with a missing segmentation key.
Pass when no record has a missing segmentation key.

steps.title: Reconcile in-force totals to the policy administration system
sop: Pull the in-force count and face amount from the policy administration system at cut-off.
Compare to the study dataset totals and document each reconciling item.
Done when the reconciliation is documented with all items listed.
verify: Check the residual variance against the agreed tolerance.
Pass when the residual variance is within tolerance and documented.

steps.title: Release the exposure dataset for study use
sop: Review the exposure basis, match results and reconciliation together.
Release the dataset version for downstream A/E work and record the release.
Done when the dataset version is released and recorded.
verify: Confirm the release record names the dataset version and date.
Pass when the release record names version and date.

steps.title: Open a register entry per changed assumption cell group
sop: Create one register entry for each changed mortality or longevity cell group.

steps.title: Separate evidence-driven change from expert judgement
sop: Classify each change as credible experience evidence or expert judgement.

Pass when no expert-judgement entry lacks a justification.

steps.title: Cite supporting exhibits by file name and version
sop: Reference the A/E, credibility and benchmarking exhibits by file name and version.

steps.title: Record effective date and first affected reporting period

verify: Compare register dates to the approval record dates.

steps.title: Note the rejected alternatives considered

verify: Read the limitations section for missing bias statements.

steps.title: Explain the credibility treatment per cell grouping

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-deployment run reconciles to the approved impact estimate within tolerance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deployment log records deployer, timestamp, version and the models touched
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Models missed in the sweep logged with a remediation date and owner
generic.Test population: All models in the inventory consuming the deployed assumption version
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No production model left on a superseded assumption version after the deployment window
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation variances above tolerance investigated before the run is accepted as production
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deployment log showing version loaded, models updated, deployer, timestamp and reconciliation
generic.Evidence location: Deployment log area of the model governance repository with run outputs retained

steps.title: Sweep the model inventory for consuming models
sop: List valuation, pricing, asset-liability and cash-flow-testing models consuming the assumption.
Confirm the list against the inventory consumption field.
Done when the consuming model list is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the inventory.
Pass when every consuming model appears.

steps.title: Run the regression on the old assumptions
sop: Run each model on the superseded assumptions before the swap.
Confirm each reproduces its prior results.
Done when every model reproduces prior results.
verify: Compare regression outputs to prior reported results.
Pass when every model reproduces within tolerance.

steps.title: Load the approved version with a checksum check
sop: Load the assumption tables from the approved versioned file.
Apply a checksum or version check on load.
Done when every load passes the version check.
verify: Read the load logs for checksum results.
Pass when every load passes its checksum check.

steps.title: Deploy to the pricing models in the same release
sop: Load the approved version into the pricing models in the same release window.
Confirm no pricing model is left behind.
Done when the pricing models carry the approved version.
verify: Query pricing models for the superseded version.
Pass when no pricing model references it.

steps.title: Run post-deployment and reconcile to the impact estimate
sop: Run each updated model and capture the results.
Reconcile the movement to the approved impact estimate.
Done when every model has a reconciliation result.
verify: Compare the movement to the estimate against tolerance.
Pass when every model reconciles within tolerance.

steps.title: Investigate variances above tolerance
sop: Investigate any reconciliation variance above tolerance.
Hold the run from production until it is explained.
Done when every out-of-tolerance variance is explained.
verify: Query accepted production runs for unexplained variances.
Pass when the query returns no rows.

steps.title: Record the deployment log
sop: Record deployer, timestamp, version loaded and models touched.
File the log in the model governance repository.
Done when the deployment log is filed.
verify: Query production models for a superseded version after the window.
Pass when no production model remains on a superseded version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumption change proposals requiring routing through peer review, Chief Actuary and Board stages
generic.In-scope period: From proposal submission through the final required approval stage for the change
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Proposal id, materiality test result, required stages, approver per stage and stage dates populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Completed approval stages match the stages required by the authority matrix for each proposal
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing record retained in the workflow tool with stage dates and approver names
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected or deferred proposals routed back to the owner with the reason recorded
generic.Test population: All assumption change proposals routed in the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No approval recorded where the approver is also the preparer of the assumption
generic.Exception handling path: Proposals attempting to skip a required stage blocked and returned to the routing owner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Routing record showing each required approval stage completed in sequence with dates and approvers
generic.Evidence location: Assumption approval workflow in the workflow tool with evidence in the governance repository

steps.title: Test each proposal against the authority matrix
sop: Apply the materiality test in the authority matrix to each proposal.
Determine whether Board approval is required.
Done when every proposal has a determined approval route.
verify: Filter proposals for a missing route determination.
Pass when every proposal has a determined route.

steps.title: Complete peer review before routing onward
sop: Confirm peer review is signed before routing to the Chief Actuary.
Block onward routing where the review is incomplete.
Done when peer review precedes onward routing.
verify: Compare peer review dates to the Chief Actuary submission dates.
Pass when review always precedes submission.

steps.title: Route stages sequentially where the matrix requires it
sop: Route required stages in sequence rather than in parallel.
Record the completion date of each stage.
Done when every stage is completed in the required order.
verify: Read the routing record for out-of-order stage dates.
Pass when every stage follows the required order.

steps.title: Confirm approver independence from the preparer
sop: Check the approver at each stage is not the preparer of the assumption.
Reassign the approval where independence fails.
Done when independence is confirmed at every stage.
verify: Query approvals where approver equals preparer.
Pass when the query returns no rows.

steps.title: Record the Board stage where required
sop: Submit proposals requiring Board approval through the board route.
Record the Board decision and date on the routing record.
Done when Board-required proposals carry a recorded decision.
verify: Filter Board-required proposals for a missing decision.
Pass when every such proposal has a decision.

steps.title: Return rejected or deferred proposals with a reason
sop: Route rejected or deferred proposals back to the owner.
Record the reason rather than closing the proposal silently.
Done when every rejection or deferral carries a reason.
verify: Query closed proposals for a missing reason.
Pass when no closed proposal lacks a reason.

steps.title: File the routing record with the change package
sop: Store the completed routing record with the change package.
Link it from the governance register entry.
Done when the routing record is filed and linked.
verify: Open the register link and confirm it reaches the routing record.
Pass when the link resolves to the routing record.
